affordance_in_statement: Select exactly **k** allowed combinations to form the crews. Your selection is valid if and only if no two chosen crews share the same specialist, the same machine, or the same time slot.

survivor_shortcuts.affordance: A crew is formed by combining exactly one specialist, one machine, and one time slot.
